title: The no-merge-onto-red-main gate reads a skipped push run as green only when a green PR run of that tree backs it
why: The gate read a run of one success and 28 skipped as main's green though no green PR run backed that tree and the parent run had a failed job, so a red parent read green.
source: Coordinator 16:05 CST Nov 13: run 43515441901 on ab27336489 is 1 success and 28 skipped, so the gate read green above a red parent. The coordinator's mistake below.
note: Rewritten 16:08 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 16:06, answering the owner's 16:06 question). A skipped push run is BY DESIGN when a green PR run of the same tree stands behind it (ruling own-769-a-narrowed-pr-push). The gap is narrower: the gate read run 43515441901 on ab27336489 (1 success, 28 skipped) as main's green while no green PR run backed that tree (#3278 was web-merged with its draft run still queued) and its parent run 43509070895 has a failed `checks` job (coordinator's reads, unchecked by triage). Fix: the gate reads a skipped push run as green only when a green PR run of that tree exists; otherwise it reads the newest run that ran its suites. A check change: test-author red case first (a skipped run with no backing green PR run over a red parent reads red or unknown; a skipped run with a backing green PR run reads green), builder, reviewer. Lane session_013NEJL2oxYMVKoXseeKacVG (coordinator's order); not started. Relations: push-skip-proven-tree, cancelled-run-blame-unknown, blame-on-finished-red-job. The runner pause at 16:05 stands on the real red (the catalog job), not on the skip; the coordinator withdrew the "mistake" line for the 16:01 go, and triage reads it the same way. Past rulings not checked. Owner 18:31 CST Nov 13 on item 781: "give better choices". Item 781 rewritten with plainer choices (a: judge only runs that ran suites; b: a plus a full run on main when the judged run is old; c: measure first, triage recommends). Stays blocked on the pick. Coordinator 19:54 CST Nov 13 (19:53): not started, blocked on owner item 781. Triage 22:58 CST Nov 13: item 781 answered c, measure first (ruling own-781-c-measure-first). Next: measure, from the REST workflow-runs list for main, how many commits back the newest run that ran the full tests sits, over the last 30 days, with the sample count. Then bring a or b to the owner with that number. PR #3297 waits. Unblocked for the measure only; the build stays unstarted until the owner picks. Triage 23:01 CST Nov 13: the lane field named session_013NEJL2oxYMVKoXseeKacVG, which is lane merge-flow-after-anthropic (PR #3297 owner), not a lane for this step; cleared. The coordinator runs a read-only Explore measure now (commits back to the newest suite-running run on main, 30 days, sample count). Triage tells the coordinator when the number can go to the owner.
